title: A closer look at my feet
alt: Through a thick, stylized Columbia window, Eagle turns its gold underside toward us. Four extended landing legs and broad footpads surround the dark descent-engine bell. Its silver crew cabin rises behind the lower stage, with the Moon's pale limb along the left edge.
context: After undocking, Eagle turned in front of Columbia so Michael Collins could inspect its extended landing gear. This moment focuses on the legs and footpads: a close inspection viewpoint rather than the wide separation composition used for the preceding beat.
interpretation: The underside viewpoint, foreground window shape, lighting, apparent scale and simplified hardware are artistic interpretations, not a reconstruction of a particular film frame. The curved mark indicates turning, not a measured flight path. This image does not assert a particular spacecraft attitude, latch count or instrument reading.
